title: Barbershop Studio
description: Self-serve multi-tenant SaaS for barbershops, with plan-gated signup and manual SINPE billing
longDescription: A multi-tenant barbershop management SaaS that grew from a single-client admin tool into a self-serve product. New shops sign up directly, upload a SINPE payment receipt for manual billing verification, and pass through an admin review queue before getting plan-gated access — no manual onboarding required. On top of that, it keeps the original real-time team coordination, service assignment, automated reporting, and custom admin panels. Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma, with receipts stored via Cloudflare R2.
outcome: Turned a single-tenant admin tool into a self-serve SaaS product — new shops sign up, upload a SINPE receipt, and get plan-gated access without manual onboarding.

title: DC Drip Website
description: Luxury IV therapy and wellness spa website for the DMV area, blending advanced medical treatments with a high-end client experience
longDescription: A full-featured website for DC Drip, a premium IV therapy and wellness spa serving the DC, Maryland, and Virginia area. The platform showcases the clinic's hydration therapy, vitamin infusions, and medical wellness services with a luxury brand aesthetic. Features include service listings, membership plans, client story testimonials, an integrated blog, and session booking capabilities. Built to reflect the brand's premium positioning and convert health-conscious visitors into loyal clients.
outcome: Session booking and membership plans built to convert health-conscious visitors into loyal, recurring clients.

title: LG Landscaping Services Website
description: Professional landscaping services website with quote requests, testimonials, and customer reviews
longDescription: A comprehensive website for LG Services, a professional landscaping and lawn care company. The platform showcases the company's expertise in lawn and landscape projects, featuring service information, customer testimonials, and quote request functionality. Built with modern web technologies, it facilitates seamless communication between the business and prospective customers while highlighting their professional capabilities and past client reviews.
outcome: Quote-request flow and a testimonial system that turn past clients into new landscaping leads.

title: 4MK Firearms LLC Website
longDescription: A website for a firearms company built with Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL. It features a custom admin panel for managing the website content and services for the company.
outcome: Custom admin panel gives a licensed firearms dealer direct control over inventory and site content.

title: Caja de Ande Seguros
description: Production website for a Costa Rican insurance agency, with online application flows and policy lookup
longDescription: Public-facing website for Caja de Ande de Seguros, a Costa Rican insurance agency. Built end to end on Ruby on Rails: an insurance product catalog with detail pages, multi-step vehicle and civil-liability application flows, coverage selection, a policy lookup integration, CMS-backed content administration, and an external chatbot. Shipped with a staging-to-production CI/CD pipeline, integration tests, and JS linting.

title: Madurez Digital — Autodiagnóstico para PYMEs
description: AI-guided digital maturity self-assessment for Costa Rican SMEs, built as a Master's thesis project
longDescription: A digital maturity assessment platform for Costa Rican tech SMEs, built for a Master's in Business Administration thesis (UNED Costa Rica). Users sign up, then have a guided conversation with Claude (Anthropic) that scores them across 4 categories, 10 dimensions, and ~40 domains on a 5-level maturity scale, then get a dashboard with charts and prioritized recommendations. Passwordless email-OTP auth, streaming SSE chat, and a scoring engine built on Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma.
